# relay_documentdb_cluster (Data Source)

Reads an existing managed DocumentDB cluster in a workspace, by ID or by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_documentdb_cluster" "catalog" {
  workspace_id = data.relay_workspace.prod.id
  name         = "catalog"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace to look in.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.

### Read-Only

- `backups_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the cluster takes scheduled backups.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Whether the platform refuses to delete the cluster.
- `endpoint_host` (String) Public read-write endpoint host. Empty until the platform publishes it.
- `endpoint_port` (Number) Public read-write endpoint port, 27017.
- `managed_by` (String) Owner tag, empty when unmanaged.
- `nodes` (Attributes Map) The cluster's node group, keyed by its label. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `phase` (String)
- `public_endpoints` (Attributes List) Public endpoints by role: `rw` and `ro`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public_endpoints))
- `ready_nodes` (Number)
- `storage` (Attributes) Volume size of every node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage))
- `total_nodes` (Number)
- `version` (String) DocumentDB version, `17` or `18`.

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>

Read-Only:

- `cloud` (String)
- `count` (Number)
- `region` (String)
- `resources` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes--resources))
- `tier` (String)
